# SummerQuest — Animal-Jam-Style 3D Den + Dress-Up: Technical Design Recommendation

## 1) Recommended approach

| Decision | Pick | One-line justification |
|---|---|---|
| **Rendering library** | **`three` + `@react-three/fiber` (v9, React-19 line). NO `drei` in MVP.** | r3f maps the scene graph onto React's reconciler so the den subscribes to the existing Zustand store with the same `useProgress(s => s.x)` idiom and gets StrictMode-safe mount/dispose for free; dropping drei avoids ~95 MB of install bloat and two Apache-2.0 transitive deps (`@mediapipe/tasks-vision`, `hls.js`) that a primitive den never needs. |
| **Avatar representation** | **Procedural low-poly from primitives (boxes/spheres/cones), one parameterized rig + `ANIMAL_SPECS` table.** | "Coarse / low-poly" is the *desired* look, so the cheap path is the wanted path; it preserves the zero-binary-asset property, retints to the 6 color tokens via a single `material.color`, and is the *only* option that actually covers the exotic roster (octopus, 2 dragons, unicorn-with-horn) that no CC0 pack ships. |
| **Accessory / anchor system** | **Slot-based, extending the *existing* `COSMETICS` catalog. Four anchors: `head` / `face` / `neck` / `back`. One item per slot.** | Reuses the one economy (no parallel outfit store); the emoji you already ship becomes the 2D HUD mirror of a 3D prop; named slots give "one hat at a time" + a derivable HUD headline-emoji + a per-species anchor-offset table authored once. |
| **Home / movement / interaction** | **Fixed isometric camera (NO user orbit), tap/click-to-move via r3f raycast against a floor plane, oversized invisible hit-proxies on furniture.** | Resolves the cross-agent conflict in favor of the kid-UX answer: a fixed camera kills the touch-gesture/scroll conflict, the disorientation/motor problem, and the motion-sickness surface for 8–9-year-olds on iPads, and makes the rAF story trivial (static scene + one short self-terminating walk tween). |

**Explicitly resolved disagreements:**
- **OrbitControls: CUT.** The `rendering` and `avatar` agents kept it; the `home` and both kid-UX/licensing stress-tests reject it. A free-orbit camera on small hands fights browser scroll/pinch and is a motion-sickness vector. **Fixed iso camera wins.** (r3f still gives the genuine low-poly *mesh* avatar the user asked for — we just lock the camera.) Defer optional orbit to a post-MVP toggle.
- **drei: CUT entirely for MVP.** The lead writeups call it "free"; the licensing stress-test measured it as the real hazard (~22 transitive deps, two Apache-2.0 ML/video packages). Native r3f raycasting replaces `<Bounds>`/click-to-move and procedural geometry replaces `useGLTF`. If an inspect-camera is ever wanted, add the single MIT `camera-controls` package directly, not all of drei.
- **`frameloop="demand"` + `useFrame` is contradictory** (a registered `useFrame` forces a continuous loop and silently defeats demand-idling). **Resolution:** MVP uses `frameloop="demand"` with **no `useFrame`**; the walk tween is a single hand-rolled, `visibilitychange`-gated rAF that calls `invalidate()` per frame and snaps-to-destination when hidden. Idle bob is post-MVP only.
- **Bundle number:** quote the user the *measured* cost — **+~234 KB gzip / ~880 KB raw**, lazy-loaded (≈1.5× the entire current 156 KB app), which is the irreducible three.js floor, **not** the optimistic "200–240 with disciplined drei imports." The math-game core path that 90% of sessions use never loads it.
- **Multi-slot now vs later:** ship multi-slot immediately — the persist-migration cost is identical later and single-slot ships a worse dress-up MVP.

## 2) How it reuses what exists

**Economy (zero new currency).** Den/accessory purchases call the existing `buyCosmetic(id, price)` → `spendCoins` path verbatim, against the same `coins` / `totalCoinsEarned` fields in `src/store/progress.ts`. A coin earned in a math quiz buys a hat with no second economy. `totalCoinsEarned` stays monotonic (collector achievements unaffected).

**Catalog (one source of truth).** We *extend* `src/lib/cosmetics.ts`'s `Cosmetic` type with **optional** 3D fields (`anchor`, `prop`) so the current 8-item array compiles unchanged. The 8 existing cosmetics map cleanly: `cap`/`grad`/`tophat`/`halo`/`crown` → `head`, `shades` → `face`, `bow` → `neck`, `rainbow` → `back` (aura). The emoji you already ship is the 2D projection of each 3D prop — one catalog, not two.

**Store (contained change, 2 read-sites).** `equippedCosmetic: string | null` is read in exactly **AppShell.tsx:7,12** and **ShopScreen.tsx:11,15** (grep-verified). We widen it to `equippedBySlot` and add **one** `headlineCosmeticEmoji(state)` selector that both sites call, so the single HUD chip in `AppShell` renders exactly as today with zero regression.

**Visual / design bar.** All den chrome (wardrobe drawer, coin pill, back-to-map link) is normal Tailwind DOM (`kid-text`, `.btn-quest`, `quest-/ocean-/island-/monster-/correct-` tokens) absolutely-positioned **over** the `<canvas>` — pixel-identical to ShopScreen/WorldMap, and Framer-free where it must always be visible (mirrors the `BarChart` discipline). The avatar body material reads `player.color`; procedural props inherit the palette tokens. A new `🏠 My Den` pill drops into the existing `flex justify-center flex-wrap gap-2` nav row at **WorldMap.tsx:48–77**, same `<Link to=… onClick={() => sfx.click()}>` + `rounded-full … hover:scale-105` pattern (use an unused shade, e.g. `bg-island-600`, to distinguish from Shop's `monster-500`). Sound reuses `src/lib/sound.ts` as-is (`sfx.enter` on open, `sfx.click` on tap/place, `sfx.victory` on purchase) — still zero audio assets.

**Routing.** One new lazy route `/den`, `RequireAvatar`-wrapped exactly like `/shop` and `/badges` in `src/App.tsx`; the existing `AppShell` HUD (coins/level/streak/avatar chip) keeps rendering above it for free.

## 3) Concrete architecture

### New files / routes
```
src/App.tsx                 (edit) const DenScreen = lazy(() => import('./screens/DenScreen'))
                                   + <Route path="/den" …> with <Suspense fallback={<DenLoading/>}>
                                     (FIRST React.lazy/Suspense in the app — scoped to this one route)
src/screens/WorldMap.tsx    (edit) add 🏠 My Den pill to nav row (lines 48–77)
src/screens/DenScreen.tsx   (new)  route shell: WebGL probe → <DenCanvas> or <SvgDen> fallback,
                                   + DOM overlay (wardrobe drawer, coin pill, back link, a11y buttons)
src/den/                    (new — STRICT LEAF: nothing outside imports from it except the lazy() above)
  DenCanvas.tsx                    <Canvas frameloop="demand" dpr={[1,1.5]}> + lights + floor + camera
  AnimalRig.tsx                    parameterized primitive critter; exposes <group name="head"/"face"/…>
  animalSpecs.ts                   ANIMAL_SPECS keyed off AvatarCreate's EMOJIS (imported, not re-typed)
  AccessoryProp.tsx                renders a Cosmetic's procedural prop at its anchor
  props.ts                         primitive prop builders (cap, halo torus, crown, glasses, bow, cape)
  useWalkTween.ts                  visibilitychange-gated rAF tween → invalidate(); snap-to-dest on hidden
src/screens/SvgDen.tsx      (new)  0-KB isometric SVG den — Suspense fallback AND WebGL-unavailable path
src/index.css               (edit) add ONE global :focus-visible ring + ONE prefers-reduced-motion rule
```

### Store additions (`src/store/progress.ts`) — the gating step
- Replace `equippedCosmetic: string | null` → `equippedBySlot: Partial<Record<AnchorSlot, string>>`.
- Keep `ownedCosmetics`, `coins`, `totalCoinsEarned`, `buyCosmetic`, `spendCoins` **unchanged**.
- `equipCosmetic(id)` → `equipCosmetic(id: string | null, slot?: AnchorSlot)` (resolves slot from the catalog item; sets/clears that key); add `unequipSlot(slot)`.
- Bump persist to **`version: 1` + `migrate`** that reads the old scalar `equippedCosmetic`, looks up its anchor, and seeds `equippedBySlot`; keep the old field readable for one release as a fallback.
- `resetPlayer()` zeroes `equippedBySlot`.
- **Verify the migrate against a real pre-existing `summerquest-progress-v1` localStorage blob before building any 3D** — there is **no git** safety net.

### Accessory-anchor data model (code-shaped sketch)
```ts
// src/lib/cosmetics.ts — extend in place; all 3D fields OPTIONAL so the current array compiles unchanged
export type AnchorSlot = 'head' | 'face' | 'neck' | 'back'

export type PropKind =
  | 'cap' | 'brimHat' | 'halo' | 'crown' | 'glasses' | 'bow' | 'cape'
  // future escape hatch — NOT used in MVP:
  // | { gltf: string }

export interface PropSpec {
  kind: PropKind
  /** local offset/rotation/scale relative to the anchor group; tuned ONCE per prop */
  pos?: [number, number, number]
  rot?: [number, number, number]
  scale?: number
  /** optional tint; defaults to a sensible per-prop color or the player color */
  color?: string
}

export interface Cosmetic {
  id: string
  emoji: string            // 2D HUD mirror of the 3D prop (existing)
  name: string             // (existing)
  price: number            // (existing)
  anchor?: AnchorSlot      // NEW (optional)
  prop?: PropSpec          // NEW (optional) — absent ⇒ emoji-only in 3D, incremental authoring
}

/** Single HUD chip: one emoji by precedence. Consumed by AppShell + ShopScreen — no duplicated logic. */
export function headlineCosmeticEmoji(equipped: Partial<Record<AnchorSlot, string>>): string | undefined {
  for (const slot of ['head', 'face', 'neck', 'back'] as const) {
    const c = cosmeticById(equipped[slot]); if (c) return c.emoji
  }
}
```
```ts
// src/den/animalSpecs.ts — anchors live on the AVATAR, props attach to them
import { EMOJIS } from '../screens/AvatarCreate'   // import the source array; adding a 13th animal = type error until spec'd

export interface AnimalSpec {
  ears: 'pointed' | 'round' | 'none'
  limbs: 'quad' | 'tentacle' | 'biped'
  snout: number
  accents?: ('hornCone' | 'pandaPatches' | 'dorsalRidge')[]
  /** per-species anchor overrides; defaults authored once, outliers (octopus/dragon) tweak here */
  anchors?: Partial<Record<AnchorSlot, { pos: [number,number,number]; scale?: number }>>
}
export const ANIMAL_SPECS: Record<(typeof EMOJIS)[number], AnimalSpec> = { /* … 12 entries … */ }
```

### How a cosmetic maps to a 3D prop (runtime)
`<DenAvatar>` renders the species body from `ANIMAL_SPECS[player.emoji]` (retinted by `player.color`), exposes `<group name="head">`/`"face"`/`"neck"`/`"back"` at the spec's anchor offsets, then iterates `equippedBySlot`: for each equipped id it looks up the `Cosmetic`, parents an `<AccessoryProp kind={prop.kind} …>` (a small set of code-built primitives) to the matching anchor group at `prop.pos/rot/scale`. The 2D HUD chip stays a single emoji via `headlineCosmeticEmoji(equippedBySlot)`. **A11y backbone:** every actionable thing also exists as a real DOM `<button>` in the overlay (Open Wardrobe, equip toggles), the `<canvas>` gets an `aria-label`, and the wardrobe shows the 4 slots as labeled zones so "one hat at a time" is visible/teachable.

## 4) Phased roadmap

### MVP — "orbit-free coarse critter wearing coin-bought hats, in one room" (smallest impressive slice)
- [ ] **Store-only change, shipped & verified first:** `equippedCosmetic` → `equippedBySlot` with `version:1` + `migrate`; add `headlineCosmeticEmoji`; update AppShell + ShopScreen to use it. Prove existing saves survive. (No 3D yet — HUD/Shop still work in 2D.)
- [ ] Extend `cosmetics.ts` with optional `anchor`/`prop`; tag the 8 existing items.
- [ ] `package.json`: install `three` + `@react-three/fiber@^9` **only**; **pin `react`/`react-dom` to `>=19.2 <19.3`** (drop the caret); add `resolve.dedupe: ['three']` in `vite.config.ts`.
- [ ] `index.css`: add one `:focus-visible` ring + one `prefers-reduced-motion` rule (cheap wins the app lacks today).
- [ ] `/den` lazy route + `RequireAvatar` + Suspense fallback; `🏠 My Den` pill in WorldMap.
- [ ] `DenCanvas`: `frameloop="demand"`, fixed iso camera, ambient + 1 directional light, **no shadows**, `dpr={[1,1.5]}`, a floor plane + **one** simple decorated room (static furniture meshes, non-interactive).
- [ ] **One generic chunky critter** recolored by `player.color` (per-species `ANIMAL_SPECS` deferred), with `head`/`face`/`neck`/`back` anchors rendering the player's **already-owned** cosmetics as primitive props.
- [ ] **Tap-to-move** via r3f raycast against the floor + a `visibilitychange`-gated walk tween (no `useFrame`); snap-to-destination when hidden.
- [ ] **Wardrobe drawer** (DOM overlay): 4 labeled slots, equips/unequips from `ownedCosmetics`, "get more in Shop" deep-link.
- [ ] `SvgDen` as a **first-class** fallback: rendered on WebGL-unavailable, `webglcontextlost`, and as the Suspense placeholder — it already delivers tap-furniture + wardrobe so the *feature ships even if 3D fails* on a given Chromebook.
- [ ] One-time first-run coaching: "Tap to walk" floor hint + pulsing wardrobe glow (reuse `pop`/`bounce-soft`, Framer-free).
- [ ] **Build assertion:** confirm `three` lands only in the `den-[hash]` chunk and the eager `index` chunk stays under ~170 KB gzip.

### v2 — "a den that's truly yours"
- [ ] Per-species `ANIMAL_SPECS` for all 12 emoji (prototype **octopus + a dragon first** to de-risk the rig; per-species anchor overrides).
- [ ] Furniture economy: `src/den/furniture.ts` (mirrors `Cosmetic` shape) + `ownedFurniture[]` / `denLayout` / `room` store fields (persist `version:2` + migrate; `buyFurniture`/`placeFurniture`/`setRoom` mirroring `buyCosmetic`); reuse ShopScreen's grid for the furniture shop.
- [ ] A few interactive furniture hotspots (oversized hit-proxies): treasure chest (reads `coins`/`totalCoinsEarned`, shows savings progress, **grants nothing**), bed/beanbag flourish (`sfx.victory`).
- [ ] Prefetch the den chunk on WorldMap idle (`requestIdleCallback`) so the tap feels instant.

### v3 — polish & delight
- [ ] Opt-in idle animation (head-bob) — strictly `visibilitychange`-gated + `prefers-reduced-motion`-respecting, drops `frameloop="demand"` only while active.
- [ ] Optional inspect-camera toggle (add MIT `camera-controls` directly, not drei).
- [ ] Multiple room themes; a single hero `.glb` behind the existing `kind:'mesh'|'gltf'` prop interface if (and only if) a specific item demands fidelity procedural geometry can't reach — the project's first deliberate binary asset.
- [ ] More cosmetics/slots as the catalog grows (layering only if a future item truly needs it).

## 5) Top risks + mitigations

| # | Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Persist migration wipes existing saves** — `summerquest-progress-v1` has no version/migrate; renaming `equippedCosmetic` silently drops state (no git rollback). | High | Ship the store change *alone, first*: `version:1` + `migrate` folding the scalar into the slot map; keep old field readable one release; **test against a real localStorage blob** before any 3D. Snapshot the dir before installing deps. |
| 2 | **React 19.3 peer-range break** — r3f v9 peers `react >=19 <19.3`; current `^19.2.6` caret floats up and a routine `npm install` throws ERESOLVE. | High | Pin `react`/`react-dom` to `>=19.2 <19.3` (or exact) in the *same* change that adds r3f; treat the eventual r3f bump as the path to 19.3 — do not plan to hold React back. |
| 3 | **`useFrame` defeats `frameloop="demand"`** → reintroduces the rAF-pause failure class the project already hit twice. | High | MVP: `frameloop="demand"` + **no `useFrame`**; walk tween is a hand-rolled, `visibilitychange`-gated rAF calling `invalidate()`, snap-to-dest on hidden (copy the discipline from `TowerDefense.tsx:31–51`, *add* the visibility handling it lacks). Idle bob deferred. |
| 4 | **Canvas is a touch + a11y black hole** — meshes aren't keyboard-reachable/announced; today's app is accidentally accessible (all `<Link>`/`<button>`); zero `:focus-visible`. | High | Mirror **every** action as a DOM `<button>` in the overlay; `aria-label` the canvas; add a global `:focus-visible` ring. Pointer-first (`onPointerDown`) + oversized invisible hit-proxies (≥64 px projected); never rely on the bare mesh or mouse-only hover. |
| 5 | **+234 KB gzip on the worst hardware** (school Chromebooks/iPads); WebGL context-loss → frozen black box. | Med | Lazy-route (90% never pay); `SvgDen` as first-class WebGL-unavailable + `webglcontextlost` fallback; cap `dpr`, no shadows/post-processing; playful "Building your den 🏠" Suspense fallback masks the chunk download + engine init. |
| 6 | **StrictMode double-mount leaks GL context / double loops.** | Med | r3f owns canvas dispose; any custom `useEffect` (the walk-tween rAF) must `cancelAnimationFrame` + be idempotent in cleanup. Keep scene construction declarative JSX. |
| 7 | **Multi-equip confuses the kid / desyncs HUD** — two head items, only last shows ("where's my crown?"). | Med | One item per slot; wardrobe shows 4 *labeled* slots so the swap is visible; HUD chip uses the single `headlineCosmeticEmoji` precedence; inside the den show all equipped props on the avatar so the chip is never the only signal. |
| 8 | **Per-species anchor drift / rig's "hard 5"** — a head anchor tuned for fox floats over octopus; no CI to catch it. | Med | MVP ships ONE generic recolored critter (defer 12 meshes to v2); `ANIMAL_SPECS` keyed off the imported `EMOJIS` array so a roster edit is a type error; prototype octopus + dragon first; keep the 2D emoji chip as the guaranteed fallback. |
| 9 | **`src/den/` leaks `three` into the core chunk** (one stray static import). | Low–Med | Keep `src/den/` a strict leaf (only the `lazy()` imports it); the **post-build bundle-size assertion is the load-bearing guard** (a re-export alone doesn't leak under Vite/Rolldown — the size check is what catches a real leak). |

## 6) Rough effort estimate

| Phase | Scope | Estimate |
|---|---|---|
| **MVP** | Store migration + `headlineCosmeticEmoji` (~0.5 day) · deps/pin/dedupe + `:focus-visible`/`prefers-reduced-motion` (~0.5 day) · `DenCanvas` + one generic critter + 4 anchors + accessory props (~1.5–2 days) · tap-to-move walk tween + visibility gating (~1 day) · wardrobe drawer + a11y overlay + coaching (~1 day) · `SvgDen` fallback + WebGL probe (~1 day) · build assertion + QA on iPad/Chromebook (~0.5 day) | **~6–7 dev-days** |
| **v2** | 12-species `ANIMAL_SPECS` (octopus/dragon first) (~2–3 days) · furniture economy + store v2 migrate + furniture shop (~2 days) · interactive hotspots (chest/bed) + prefetch (~1 day) | **~5–6 dev-days** |
| **v3** | Idle anim (gated) (~0.5 day) · inspect-camera toggle (~0.5 day) · room themes + optional hero `.glb` interface (~1–2 days) · catalog growth (ongoing) | **~2–3 dev-days** |

**Net MVP outcome:** a walkable, fixed-iso, coarse low-poly 3D critter wearing accessories funded entirely by existing coins, in one decorated room with a slot-based wardrobe — shipped in a single ~234 KB-gzip lazy chunk the math-game path never loads, with a 0-KB SVG den as the always-safe degradation target, the zero-binary-asset property intact, and existing kid saves protected.
